name: FNCE 4440
title: Financial Ethics
description: Provides an understanding of the importance of ethics in the finance profession. The focus is on the concept that capital markets operate on trust; topic coverage includes professionalism and integrity of the capital markets, duties to clients and employers, investment analysis and recommendations, and conflicts of interest.
requirement_description: BLAW 3175 or BADM 3720; open only to business majors of junior or higher status.
